init_ddp: initialize distributed data parallel training using a rendezvous file and process rank
average_metrics: average metrics across all distributed processes using all_reduce with weighted counts
wrap_model_ddp: wrap a PyTorch model with DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU training
barrier_sync: synchronize all distributed processes with a barrier when world size is greater than one
create_distributed_loader: create a DataLoader with DistributedSampler for training or manual sharding for evaluation
